title: Best Dehydrator ever
text: Best Dehydrator ever. I really love this dehydrator it’s so easy to use clean so far I’ve only made jerky but wow no more store bought jersey for us

product_metadata.title: COLZER Food-Dehydrator Machine, 8 Stainless Steel Trays (67 Recipes) Dehydrator for food and Jerky, Food-Dryer Machine for Home Use, Dryer for Fruit, Meat, Dog Treats, Herbs, Vegetables,with Adjustable Timer and 70-190ºF Temperature Control
features: 🔎【Buy with confidence】 COLZER food dehydrator is upgraded with row drying fans and air circulation technology, the wind speed is 2m/s and rotation speed is 1600rpm. These technologies provides an efficient food drying process and prevents the shell from overheating.Official sales only at COLZER-US stores
🍬【Food-grade Stainless Steel】Food dehydrator Made with 100% BPA-free food-grade stainless steel and glass front door, convenient for you to track the progress of drying.

🍍【8 trays Large Capacity】COLZER dehydrator have large feet of drying space, with 8-trays, each tray is 250*250mm, to dry various vegetables, fruits, meat, flowers, and other foods and lock the minerals and vitamins in the food easily.

🍇【Safety Use】This dehydrator with automatic shutdown function and overheats protection function. The integrated air-circulating fan generates forced hot-air convection and provides uniform heat that evenly heats all the trays.

⏰【Digital Settings】Dehydrator digital temperatures preset settings ranging from 68ºF to 194ºF by 5℉ increments (support Fahrenheit only) , and adjust the drying time to The 24-hour timer in increments of 0.5 hours, It provide accurate drying times and temperatures.

🍋【Noise=45dB】Waiting for food dehydration after setting the time and temperature, horizontal airflow system, rear motor, and fan to ensure more uniform drying, quiet operation, dehydrator noise is only 45dB.

🌮【67 Recipe Instructions】 This COLZER food dehydrator machine also comes with an exclusive 67 Recipe Cookbook, made by our professional COLZER chefs. The dryer also comes with 1*door handle, 1*drip tray, 1*pair of silicone gloves, 1*screwdriver, and a food dehydrator instruction manual.

❤【Lifetime After-sales Guarantee】 Your purchase will receive lifetime assistance from our helpful customer support team. If there is any quality problem within 1 year, we can replace the new food dehydrator machine for you (no need to return the original machine) If you encounter any problems, please feel free to contact our customer service.
